comment: The Client Registry is presented as supporting accurate denominators. A registry of service users is not a population denominator and may systematically omit people who do not access care, migrants, mobile populations and marginalized groups. Using it as a denominator can bias coverage estimates and intensify identity linkage without analytical benefit.

public.text: The Client Registry is presented as supporting accurate denominators. A registry of service users is not a population denominator and may systematically omit people who do not access care, migrants, mobile populations and marginalized groups. Using it as a denominator can bias coverage estimates and intensify identity linkage without analytical benefit.
public.suggestedRevision:
Instead use "accurate calculation of  denominators for healthcare utilization indicators"

Use census and population projections, CRVS, surveys, catchment estimates and other validated population sources for denominators, with uncertainty documented.
